channel.title: WillowinWorld Devlog
channel.description: Latest production notes for WillowinWorld mobile games.

item.title: Nature Seed: Public beta preparation
item.description: Mobile optimization, onboarding, level readability and restoration feedback are moving toward the July 2026 public beta.

item.title: Candy Shop: Internal beta and optimization
item.description: Candy Shop is being tested internally with focus on mobile performance, UI polish, candy balance and combo readability.

item.title: Paint Blasters: Design expansion and polish
item.description: The core mechanics are implemented in draft form while projectile readability, tower clarity and final scope are refined.

item.title: Ball is God?!: Project scope review
item.description: Active production is paused after a major story and world-planning pass, with continuation planned after current releases.
